title: Green Lentil, Sweet Potato and Pumpkin Stew
subtitle: served over white rice
description: A quick vegetarian meal of green lentils with sweet potato, pumpkin, red cabbage and pomegranate molasses, served on rice.

steps.text: Cook the lentils in a pot with plenty of water until softened, about 25 minutes. Drain, cool and transfer to a bowl. Keep about 1/4 cup of the cooking water.
Cook the rice according to the packet directions.
Finely chop the onion and garlic and cut the sweet potato and pumpkin into cubes. Slice the red cabbage into thin strips.
While the lentils and rice cook, heat the oil in a frying pan, add the onion and fry for about 8 minutes. Add the garlic, sweet potato, pumpkin and honey and fry for another 10 minutes.
Add the red cabbage and fry for another 4-5 minutes. Meanwhile, chop the parsley and coriander.
Add the spices, pomegranate molasses, parsley and coriander to the pan, then the drained lentils and about 1/4 cup of the cooking water. Cook for another 10 minutes.
